64532-the-lore-of-the-honey-bee.creator: Unknown
64532-the-lore-of-the-honey-bee.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ONE of the oldest and prettiest fables in ancient mythology is that which deals with the origin of the honey-bee. It was to Melissa and her sister Amalthea, the beautiful daughters of the King of Crete, that the god Jupiter was entrusted by his mother Ops, when Saturn, his father—following his custom of devouring his children at birth—sought to make the usual meal of this, his latest offspring.

arxiv-2110-08837.title: Category-theoretical Semantics of the Description Logic 𝒜 ​ ℒ ​ 𝒞 \mathcal{ALC} (extended version)
arxiv-2110-08837.creator: Chan Le Duc
arxiv-2110-08837.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chan Le Duc. Category theory can be used to state formulas in First-Order Logic without using set membership. Several notable results in logic such as proof of the continuum hypothesis can be elegantly rewritten in category theory. We propose in this paper a reformulation of the usual set-theoretical semantics of the description logic 𝒜 ​ ℒ ​ 𝒞 \mathcal{ALC} by using categorical language.

arxiv-2210-01309.title: Joint Optimization of Active and Passive Beamforming in Multi-IRS Aided mmWave Communications Thanks: This work was supported in part by the NSFC under Grant 62001071, 62101460 and 62061007, the Macao Young Scholars Program under Grant AM2021018, the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation under Grant
arxiv-2210-01309.creator: Renlong Wei, Qing Xue, Shaodan Ma, Yongjun Xu, Li Yan, Xuming Fang
arxiv-2210-01309.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Renlong Wei, Qing Xue, Shaodan Ma, Yongjun Xu, Li Yan, Xuming Fang. Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has been considered as a promising technology to alleviate the blockage effect and enhance coverage in millimeter wave (mmWave) communication. To explore the impact of IRS on the performance of mmWave communication, we investigate a multi-IRS assisted mmWave communication network and formulate a sum rate maximization problem by jointly optimizing the active and passive beamforming and the set of IRSs for assistance.

arxiv-2210-09802.title: NFGen: Automatic Non-linear Function Evaluation Code Generator for General-purpose MPC Platforms Conference: Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security; November 7–11, 2022; Los Angeles, CA, USA. Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3548606.3560565 ISBN: 978-1-4503-94
arxiv-2210-09802.creator: Xiaoyu Fan, Kun Chen, Guosai Wang, Mingchun Zhuang, Yi Li, Wei Xu
arxiv-2210-09802.description: Abstract . Due to the absence of a library for non-linear function evaluation, so-called general-purpose secure multi-party computation (MPC) are not as “general” as MPC programmers expect. Prior arts either naively reuse plaintext methods, resulting in suboptimal performance and even incorrect results, or handcraft ad hoc approximations for specific functions or platforms.

arxiv-2308-03705.title: Combining Proofs for Description Logic and Concrete Domain Reasoning (Technical Report)
arxiv-2308-03705.creator: Christian Alrabbaa, Franz Baader, Stefan Borgwardt, Patrick Koopmann, Alisa Kovtunova
arxiv-2308-03705.description: Abstract Logic-based approaches to AI have the advantage that their behavior can in principle be explained with the help of proofs of the computed consequences. For ontologies based on Description Logic (DL), we have put this advantage into practice by showing how proofs for consequences derived by DL reasoners can be computed and displayed in a user-friendly way.

arxiv-2310-12780.title: Towards a Unified Quantum Protocol Framework: Classification, Implementation, and Use Cases
arxiv-2310-12780.creator: Shraddha Singh *, Mina Doosti *, Natansh Mathur, Mahshid Delavar, Atul Mantri, Harold Ollivier, Elham Kashefi
arxiv-2310-12780.description: Abstract We present a framework for the unification and standardization of quantum network protocols, making their realization easier and expanding their use cases to a broader range of communities interested in quantum technologies. Our framework is available as an open-source repository, the Quantum Protocol Zoo.

arxiv-2310-13336.title: FLAIR: a Country-Scale Land Cover Semantic Segmentation Dataset From Multi-Source Optical Imagery
arxiv-2310-13336.creator: Anatol Garioud, Nicolas Gonthier, Loic Landrieu, Apolline De Wit, Marion Valette, Marc Poupée, Sébastien Giordano, Boris Wattrelos
arxiv-2310-13336.description: Abstract We introduce the French Land cover from Aerospace ImageRy (FLAIR), an extensive dataset from the French National Institute of Geographical and Forest Information (IGN) that provides a unique and rich resource for large-scale geospatial analysis. FLAIR contains high-resolution aerial imagery with a ground sample distance of 20 cm and over 20 billion individually labeled pixels for precise land-cover classification.

arxiv-2402-08503.title: Spread construction for (36,15,6) Hadamard difference sets
arxiv-2402-08503.creator: Ken Smith, Jordan Webster
arxiv-2402-08503.description: Abstract . There are exactly 35 inequivalent ( 36 , 15 , 6 ) (36,15,6) difference sets in nine groups. Eight of the nine groups have a normal Sylow 3-subgroup. We give a straightforward “spread” construction which explains the 32 inequivalent difference sets in these eight groups.

arxiv-2402-12504.title: Sensitivity of transverse momentum correlations to early-stage and thermal fluctuations
arxiv-2402-12504.creator: Oleh Savchuk
arxiv-2402-12504.description: Abstract Transverse momentum correlations were recently measured by the ALICE collaboration at the LHC Acharya et al. 2020 . A long-range structure in terms of relative pseudorapidity of particle pairs is observed. This may imply some signal of the initial state owing to the shear spread of the correlation.

arxiv-2412-05943.title: Adversarial Transferability in Deep Denoising Models: Theoretical Insights and Robustness Enhancement via Out-of-Distribution Typical Set Sampling Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2412-05943.creator: Jie Ning, Jiebao Sun, Shengzhu Shi, Zhichang Guo, Yao Li, Hongwei Li, Boying Wu
arxiv-2412-05943.description: Abstract Deep learning-based image denoising models demonstrate remarkable performance, but their lack of robustness analysis remains a significant concern. A major issue is that these models are susceptible to adversarial attacks, where small, carefully crafted perturbations to input data can cause them to fail.

arxiv-2412-16033.title: Cosmological Non-Gaussianity from Neutrino Seesaw Mechanism
arxiv-2412-16033.creator: Jingtao You, Linghao Song, Hong-Jian He, Chengcheng Han
arxiv-2412-16033.description: Abstract The neutrino mass generation via conventional seesaw mechanism is realized at high scales around O ⁡ ( 10 14 ) O(10^{14})\hskip 0.85358pt GeV with natural Yukawa couplings of O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) , making the test of neutrino seesaw a great challenge.

arxiv-2502-16794.title: AAD-LLM: Neural Attention-Driven Auditory Scene Understanding
arxiv-2502-16794.creator: Xilin Jiang, Sukru Samet Dindar, Vishal Choudhari, Stephan Bickel, Ashesh Mehta, Guy M McKhann, Daniel Friedman, Adeen Flinker, Nima Mesgarani
arxiv-2502-16794.description: Abstract Auditory foundation models, including auditory large language models (LLMs), process all sound inputs equally, independent of listener perception. However, human auditory perception is inherently selective: listeners focus on specific speakers while ignoring others in complex auditory scenes. Existing models do not incorporate this selectivity, limiting their ability to generate perception-aligned responses.

arxiv-2508-06986.description: Abstract . Human mobility prediction is vital for urban planning, transportation optimization, and personalized services. However, the inherent randomness, non-uniform time intervals, and complex patterns of human mobility, compounded by the heterogeneity introduced by varying city structures, infrastructure, and population densities, present significant challenges in modeling.

arxiv-2509-17004.title: Counting conjugacy classes and automorphism-conjugacy classes of ZM-groups
arxiv-2509-17004.creator: Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2509-17004.description: Abstract In this paper, we count the number of conjugacy and automorphism-conjugacy classes of elements of a ZM-group. The size of a conjugacy class with respect to these two equivalence relations is also counted. MSC2020 : Primary 20D60; Secondary 20D45, 11A25. Key words : conjugacy class, automorphism-conjugacy class, ZM-group, group action, Burnside’s lemma, Menon’s identity.

arxiv-2601-05237.title: ObjectForesight : Predicting Future 3D Object Trajectories from Human Videos
arxiv-2601-05237.creator: Rustin Soraki, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Ali Farhadi, Roozbeh Mottaghi, [0.5em] University of Washington, Carnegie Mellon University, [0.3em] Equal advising [0.2em]
arxiv-2601-05237.description: Abstract Humans can effortlessly anticipate how objects might move or change through interaction—imagining a cup being lifted, a knife slicing, or a lid being closed. We aim to endow computational systems with a similar ability to predict plausible future object motions directly from passive visual observation.

arxiv-2601-06504.title: Superconductivity in epitaxial PtSb(0001) thin films
arxiv-2601-06504.creator: C. Müller, S. P. Bommanaboyena, A. Badura, T. Uchimura, F. Husstedt, B. V. Schwarze, S. Banerjee, M. Ledinský, J. Michalicka, M. Míšek, M. Šindler, T. Helm, S. Fukami, F. Krizek, D. Kriegner
arxiv-2601-06504.description: Abstract We report superconductivity in epitaxial PtSb(0001) thin films grown on SrF 2 \text{SrF}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} (111). Electrical transport measurements reveal a superconducting transition at T c = 1.72 K T_{\mathrm{c}}=$1.72\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ . The field-induced broadening of the transition and the presence of finite upper critical fields are consistent with type-II superconductivity.

arxiv-2601-14503.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Wouter Termont, Esteves Beatriz. Recent European efforts around digital identity – the EUDI regulation and its OpenID architecture – aim high, but start from a narrow and ill-defined conceptualization of authentication. arxiv-2602-10690.title: Magneto-optical properties of the neutral silicon-vacancy center in diamond under extreme isotropic strain fields
arxiv-2602-10690.creator: Meysam Mohseni, Gergő Thiering, Adam Gali
arxiv-2602-10690.description: Abstract The neutral silicon–vacancy (SiV 0 ) center in diamond combines inversion symmetry with optical emission, making it a robust quantum emitter resilient to stray electric fields. Using first-principles density-functional theory, we quantify its response to isotropic strain spanning strong compression and tensile regimes (effective hydrostatic pressures of approximately − 80 -80 to 180 180 GPa).

pmc-10530930.title: Vesicular Release and Uptake of Circular LSD1-RNAs from Non-Cancer and Cancer Lung Cells
pmc-10530930.creator: Joelle Noriko Galang, Yefeng Shen, Ulrike Koitzsch, Xiaojie Yu, Hannah Eischeid-Scholz, Daniel Bachurski, Tilman T. Rau, Christina Neppl, Marco Herling, Bianca Bulimaga, Elena Vasyutina, Michal R. Schweiger, Reinhard Büttner, Margarete Odenthal, Maria M. Anokhina
pmc-10530930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1) is highly expressed in many cancer types and strongly associated with cancer progression and metastasis. Circular RNAs (circRNAs) are produced by back-splicing and influence the interactive RNA network by microRNA and protein sponging. In the present study, we aimedto identify circRNAs that derive from the LSD1-encoding KDM1A gene, and to investigate their potential to be released and uptaken by lung cancer versus non-cancer epithelial cells. We identified four circLSD1-RNAs by RT-PCR with divergent primers, followed by sequencing.

pmc-10594455.title: Nasal CPAP in the Pediatric Ward to Reduce PICU Admissions for Severe Bronchiolitis?
pmc-10594455.creator: Melodie O Aricò, Diana Wrona, Giovanni Lavezzo, Enrico Valletta, Pietro Vajro
pmc-10594455.description: In treating acute bronchiolitis in infants, the decision to use continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) often involves infant referral from the pediatric ward to the pediatric intensive care unit (PICU). We present our experience of CPAP use in a general pediatric ward, aiming to reduce the pressure on the PICU in recent outbreaks of bronchiolitis.

pmc-11506817.title: Vitamin D Supplementation for Children with Epilepsy on Antiseizure Medications: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11506817.creator: Fahad A. Bashiri, Abrar Hudairi, Muddathir H. Hamad, Lujain K. Al-Sulimani, Doua Al Homyani, Dimah Al Saqabi, Amal Y. Kentab, Reem A. Al Khalifah
pmc-11506817.description: Background: Antiseizure medications (ASMs) are crucial for managing epilepsy in children. However, a well-documented side effect of ASMs is their impact on bone health, often due to interference with vitamin D metabolism. This can lead to vitamin D deficiency in children with epilepsy.

pmc-11585526.title: Bismuth sensitized iron oxide on exfoliated graphene oxide (Bi–Fe2O3@GO) for oxygen evaluation reaction
pmc-11585526.creator: Akhtar Munir, Shaheer Jamal, Humaira Yasmeen Gondal, Javed Iqbal, Aamir Hussain, Arslan Aziz, Mahammad Nisar, Muhammad Zubair, Abdul Momin, Ali Haider
pmc-11585526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Electrochemical water splitting is a promising approach towards a sustainable and renewable energy source. However, the demand for high anodic potential and sluggish kinetics of oxygen evolution reaction (OER) restrict the efficiency and feasibility of the water-splitting process. In this quest, transition metal oxides and alloys are considered potential candidates owing to their natural occurrence and high redox potential for OER. However, many associated challenges in their use are still there to be addressed.

pmc-11680274.title: Development and Evaluation of a Newcastle Disease Virus-like Particle Vaccine Expressing SARS-CoV-2 Spike Protein with Protease-Resistant and Stability-Enhanced Modifications
pmc-11680274.creator: Yu Chen, Fan Tian, Shunlin Hu, Xiufan Liu
pmc-11680274.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The ongoing global health crisis caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) necessitates the continuous development of innovative vaccine strategies, especially in light of emerging viral variants that could undermine the effectiveness of existing vaccines. In this study, we developed a recombinant virus-like particle (VLP) vaccine based on the Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV) platform, displaying a stabilized prefusion form of the SARS-CoV-2 spike (S) protein.

pmc-12797490.title: Understanding professional disparities in academic anesthesiology: a single-center gender-based survey study
pmc-12797490.creator: Anne L. Donovan, Joyce Chang, Jina Sinskey, Rachel Schwartz
pmc-12797490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWomen in academic anesthesiology face numerous structural and cultural barriers that impede academic advancement and threaten career longevity. Understanding the impact of these challenges can allow steps to be taken to improve gender equity and retention in academic anesthesiology.MethodsThis study describes a voluntary, anonymous survey distributed to faculty members in the Department of Anesthesia & Perioperative Care at an urban tertiary care academic Health System with a variety of anesthetizing locations across six hospitals.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2000cc5.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2000cc5.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 21C (Protection Of Religious Exercise In Land Use And By Institutionalized Persons). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Claimant The term “claimant” means a person raising a claim or defense under this chapter. (2) Demonstrates The term “demonstrates” means meets the burdens of going forward with the evidence.
